title: Columbia 12 in. Quick Clean Flat Box

title: Columbia Angle Head Adaptor

title: Columbia Corner Flusher Box
description: The Columbia Corner Flusher Box is used with an attached Angle Head/Corner Finisher on the second and third coats. This box is specially angled to access tight corners and the stainless-steel cone dispenses proper amount of drywall compound smoothly.

title: Columbia Corner Roller and Handles

title: Columbia Corner Cobra

title: Columbia Finishing Set
description: The Columbia Finishing Set includes everything you need for consistent, professional grade drywall finishing. This set is designed for the professional drywaller and is customizable according to the way you prefer to work. Commercial Grade, Lightweight, Durable.

title: Columbia Flat Box Set

title: Columbia Taping Tools Full Set
description: The Columbia Taping Tools Full Set includes everything you need for professional taping and finishing.  This set is highly customizable, allowing you to choose options and upgrades according to the way you work.

title: Columbia Gooseneck

title: Columbia Outside 90 Degree Bead Roller
description: The Columbia Outside 90 Degree Corner Roller squares up tape on cornerbead and applies even pressure as you roll the bead in place. This roller is designed for smooth, effortless application. Made from solid US billet aluminum and steel components with a 1.75-inch thickness.

title: Columbia Outside 90 Degree Mud Applicator

title: Columbia Max Set

title: Columbia Outside Bullnose Bead Roller

title: Columbia Tall Boy Gooseneck
